ideas.title: Capability Home Pages
ideas.summary: Give every major capability one permanent routing home across tools/pages.

ideas.title: Plan Families
ideas.summary: Group related plans under stable family IDs with one survivor.

ideas.title: Automatic Similar-Plan Detection
ideas.summary: Detect likely overlapping plans before creating another one.

ideas.title: Mandatory Existing Work Checked Section
ideas.summary: Require prior-art search before new plans/systems are created.

ideas.title: Universal Work Packet
ideas.summary: Standardize agent/conversation/plan-to-code handoff payloads.

ideas.title: Capability IDs Everywhere
ideas.summary: Attach durable work records to CAP IDs for automatic clustering.

ideas.title: Plan Merge Records
ideas.summary: Record source plans, survivor and harvested material for every merge.

ideas.title: Feature Idea Registry
ideas.summary: Keep ideas separate from committed tasks while preserving provenance.

ideas.title: Idea-to-Capability Routing
ideas.summary: Route each idea to an existing capability before considering a new one.

ideas.title: Code Ownership Map
ideas.summary: Map capabilities to source paths, tests, routes/services and confidence.

ideas.title: Bidirectional Code ↔ Document Links
ideas.summary: Documents point to code owners, and important code modules link back to their governing capability/specification.

ideas.title: Change Impact Graph
ideas.summary: Given a changed file, identify affected capabilities, plans, tasks, docs, tests, UI surfaces and integrations.

ideas.title: Unified Before Building Gate
ideas.summary: Before implementation begins, resolve capability owner, prior art, current code, existing tasks, active PRs and related prototypes.

ideas.title: Convergence Inbox
ideas.summary: Route new ideas from conversations, audits, research, bugs, prototypes and agents into one review queue instead of immediately creating documents/tasks.

ideas.title: Conversation Work Harvester
ideas.summary: At the end of substantial conversations, extract completed work, incomplete work, decisions, bugs, opportunities, rejected directions and ideas into governed intake.

ideas.title: Cross-Conversation Similarity Review
ideas.summary: Compare new conversation work against prior conversation-intake packages to detect duplicate plans/tasks.

ideas.title: Plan-to-Task Compiler
ideas.summary: Convert accepted plan sections into Task Authority mutation proposals while preserving plan/capability/acceptance/dependency links.

ideas.title: Task-to-Plan Backlinks
ideas.summary: Every task should know which plan/program/specification created or justifies it.

ideas.title: Task Completion Feedback Into Plans
ideas.summary: When tasks become verified DONE, update owning plan maturity/progress projections instead of copying status prose.

ideas.title: Plan Maturity Model
ideas.summary: Track Architecture, Backend, Frontend, Integration, Tests, Runtime, Responsive, Documentation and Release maturity instead of vague almost-finished states.

ideas.title: Feature Cluster Documents
ideas.summary: For systems with many related improvements, maintain one compact living feature-cluster document instead of many micro-plans.

ideas.title: Debugging Family Records
ideas.summary: Group related bugs under stable debug/root-cause families.

ideas.title: Root-Cause Promotion
ideas.summary: Promote shared root causes above repeated symptom fixes.

ideas.title: Fix Once / Prevent Everywhere Rule
ideas.summary: Prefer shared primitive/service/schema fixes over repeated local patches.

ideas.title: Duplicate-Code Detection Reports
ideas.summary: Find repeated stores/services/hooks/schemas/CSS/provider clients.

ideas.title: Simplification Proposals
ideas.summary: Use a formal simplification work type for collapsing overlapping implementations.

ideas.title: Removal Governance
ideas.summary: Require reachability/replacement/donor/rollback evidence before deletion.

ideas.title: Quarantine Registry
ideas.summary: Track uncertain legacy code/docs/prototypes with removal gates.

ideas.title: Implementation Family Graphs
ideas.summary: Classify parallel implementations as canonical/adapter/compatibility/migration/donor/remove.

ideas.title: Architecture Simplification Scoreboard
ideas.summary: Track reductions in duplicate stores/routes/schemas/state owners/bridges.

ideas.title: Integration Seam Registry
ideas.summary: Record important system-to-system contracts and failure states.

ideas.title: Handoff Contract Library
ideas.summary: Define reusable Project/Asset/Evidence/Generation/Publishing/Outcome handoffs.

ideas.title: Universal Provenance Envelope
ideas.summary: Use shared provenance fields for AI/assets/actions/renders/publish/outcomes.

ideas.title: Shared Decision Registry
ideas.summary: Assign stable IDs to durable product/architecture decisions.

ideas.title: Decision Conflict Detection
ideas.summary: Flag new plans that contradict existing decisions/authorities.

ideas.title: Assumption Registry
ideas.summary: Track unverified assumptions separately from facts/decisions.

ideas.title: Open Questions Queue
ideas.summary: Track unresolved research/creator/architecture questions separately from tasks.

ideas.title: Verification Debt Registry
ideas.summary: Track implementation that lacks required runtime/visual/auth/deploy verification.

ideas.title: Evidence Bundles
ideas.summary: Collect tests/screenshots/logs/runtime/PR/deployment evidence under receipt IDs.

ideas.title: Screenshot Certification Records
ideas.summary: Standardize desktop/mobile/orientation screenshot evidence records.

ideas.title: Document Health Audit
ideas.summary: Detect stale SHA metadata, duplicate authorities, broken supersession and orphan docs.

ideas.title: Plan Health Audit
ideas.summary: Flag plans with no active tasks, no owner, no acceptance criteria, no code links, staleness or substantial overlap with another plan.

ideas.title: Capability Coverage Audit
ideas.summary: Show authority/code/tasks/tests/UI/Guide/verification coverage per capability.

ideas.title: Agent Context Builder
ideas.summary: Assemble the smallest correct task context package on demand.

ideas.title: Just-in-Time Documentation Retrieval
ideas.summary: Retrieve only relevant authority sections and references for the task.

ideas.title: Reusable Workflow Registry
ideas.summary: Make repeatable development workflows first-class governed objects.

ideas.title: Skill-to-Workflow Mapping
ideas.summary: Map workflows to the skills used at each stage.

ideas.title: Improvement Recommendation Log
ideas.summary: Persist deduped architecture/performance/UX/AI/tooling recommendations before task promotion.

ideas.title: Unified Development Control Room
ideas.summary: Generate one projection of capabilities/plans/tasks/missions/risks/evidence/ideas/questions/verification debt.

ideas.title: Convergence-First Governance Rule
ideas.summary: Require reuse/merge/generalize/adapt attempts before new parallel systems.

ideas.title: Unified YouTube Studio Control Center
ideas.summary: A single ViewTube workspace that merges supported channel, video, playlist, comment, subscription, membership, live, analytics and revenue controls behind one account-scoped command surface. It should show whether each control is **directly writable**, **read-only**, **requires YouTube Studio**, or **blocked by permissions**, so the product never implies unsupported authority.

ideas.title: Publish, Schedule and Post-Publish Operations Console
ideas.summary: Extend the Publisher into a full YouTube operations console for upload, title/description/tags, thumbnail, captions where supported, visibility, audience settings, scheduling, premiere/live handoff, playlist placement, remote verification, retry/recovery and post-publish metadata updates. The ApprovedPublishSnapshot should remain the immutable approval boundary.
similarityKeys: publish, schedule and post-publish operations console

ideas.title: Channel Customization and Homepage Architect
ideas.summary: Manage supported channel branding and channel sections/shelves from ViewTube, with a visual preview of how playlists, popular uploads, featured groups and channel sections will appear. Where YouTube exposes only partial customization control, ViewTube should guide the creator to the exact remaining Studio action.

ideas.title: Comment and Community Operations Inbox
ideas.summary: Combine comment threads, replies, moderation state, spam/report actions where supported, creator notes, saved reply styles, suggested-video routing and audience intelligence into one triage workspace. High-volume channels should get batch filters, sentiment/theme clustering and “needs creator attention” prioritization without auto-posting unless explicitly allowed.

ideas.title: Playlist, Series and Content Architecture Manager
ideas.summary: Create, edit, reorder and organize playlists and playlist items; connect each playlist to Projects, series strategy, end-screen routing and channel sections. Add playlist health metrics, missing-video alerts, duplicate placement detection and sequence recommendations based on actual viewer flows.
similarityKeys: playlist, series and content architecture manager

ideas.title: Live Control Room
ideas.summary: Create and schedule broadcasts, bind streams, monitor stream health, manage eligible live settings, operate live chat moderation, moderators/bans and supported monetization/cuepoint controls, and preserve the resulting livestream as a normal ContentBuild/video after the event.

ideas.title: Analytics, Revenue and Membership Intelligence Center
ideas.summary: Unify YouTube Analytics/Reporting metrics and dimensions for views, watch time, retention, traffic, devices, geography, subscribers, playlists, livestreams, estimated revenue, ad performance, Premium revenue and available membership signals. Every number should retain unit, scope, window, format and provenance so comparisons pass the canonical metric-compatibility guard.
similarityKeys: analytics, revenue and membership intelligence center

ideas.title: Subscriber, Subscription and Member Relationship Center
ideas.summary: Separate three commonly confused concepts: channel subscriber performance, the authenticated account's own subscriptions, and channel membership data available to eligible channels. Build cohort views, churn/cancellation-reason analysis where data exists, member-perk tracking, subscriber conversion paths and relationship history without pretending that private subscriber identities are universally available.
similarityKeys: subscriber, subscription and member relationship center

ideas.title: Monetization, Shopping and Commerce Operations Hub
ideas.summary: Combine revenue analytics, ad-performance signals, Premium revenue, Super Chat/Super Thanks-style event data where available, memberships and YouTube Shopping/merchant readiness into one commerce workspace. Shopping controls that are not exposed by a supported API should appear as synchronized status, checklist and deep-link handoffs rather than fake in-app controls.
similarityKeys: monetization, shopping and commerce operations hub

ideas.title: Content Planning Calendar with YouTube State Synchronization
ideas.summary: One calendar for Projects, drafts, scheduled uploads, premieres, livestreams, campaign moments, community tasks and post-publish checkpoints. It should reconcile planned ViewTube dates with actual YouTube publish/live state and flag drift, missed deadlines, competing releases, missing assets and under-supported launch windows.
similarityKeys: content planning calendar with youtube state synchronization

ideas.title: Flow / Veo Scene Director inside Video Director
ideas.summary: Turn a storyboard shot, reference frame, Asset Slot or selected Vault media into Veo scene generations, including portrait 9:16 outputs, first/last-frame continuity, ingredients/reference guidance and native audio when available. Generated clips should return as versioned assets with prompt/model/provenance metadata.
similarityKeys: flow / veo scene director inside video director

ideas.title: Nano Banana Thumbnail and Key-Art Lab
ideas.summary: Use Nano Banana 2/Pro for thumbnail ideation, controlled image editing, subject consistency, text-aware compositions, background replacement, visual cleanup and variant generation. It should operate on existing thumbnail assets rather than create a parallel image store.
similarityKeys: nano banana thumbnail and key-art lab

ideas.title: Gemini Omni Multimodal Remix Workbench
ideas.summary: Let creators drop text, images, audio and video references into one workspace and ask for a cohesive remix plan or generated output. Use cases include transforming an existing Short into a new visual concept, creating alternate hooks from footage, or adapting long-form material into several platform-ready variants.

ideas.title: Flow Agent Batch Creative Director
ideas.summary: Map Flow Agent-style multi-step planning into ViewTube Projects: generate several scene variants, batch-edit a recurring visual choice, organize generated assets into collections and propose the next creative action while preserving explicit creator approval gates.

ideas.title: Flow Tools / Creator Workflow Recipe Builder
ideas.summary: Create reusable visual workflow recipes such as “historical map → cinematic establishing shot → 9:16 crop → title card → music cue” or “product image → three ad concepts → six hook variants.” Where Flow Tools are not directly callable, export structured recipes/prompts and re-import resulting assets.
similarityKeys: flow tools / creator workflow recipe builder

ideas.title: Flow Music / Lyria Soundtrack Studio
ideas.summary: Generate project-scoped music beds, stingers, transitions and theme variations using Lyria-powered workflows, with duration, mood, tempo, intensity and edit-marker controls. Track usage rights/provenance and route approved audio directly into Editor/Vault.

ideas.title: Gemini Notebook Creator Research Room
ideas.summary: Create one source-grounded notebook per Project, series or channel topic containing research documents, transcripts, links, notes and prior videos. Use it to produce cited research answers, briefs, FAQs, timelines, Audio/Video Overviews and reusable evidence packets for the Brain.

ideas.title: Gemini Deep Research Topic Intelligence
ideas.summary: Run structured research for upcoming videos, competitors/topics, historical claims, product comparisons or audience questions, then convert the result into a ViewTube Evidence Pack with sources, confidence, freshness and explicit claims requiring human verification.

ideas.title: Gemini Live Studio Copilot
ideas.summary: Add an optional voice-first copilot for brainstorming, script rehearsal, live editing decisions, shot review and hands-free navigation in the Studio Hub. The copilot should control ViewTube tools through typed actions rather than directly manipulating state outside canonical owners.

ideas.title: Google Photos / Personal Intelligence Reference Picker
ideas.summary: With explicit opt-in, allow creators to discover relevant personal photos or visual references from connected Google context for autobiographical content, thumbnails or B-roll planning. Nothing should be imported into Vault until the creator selects it.
similarityKeys: google photos / personal intelligence reference picker

ideas.title: Gemini API Model Router and Experiment Bench
ideas.summary: Build a controlled model-testing surface that compares Gemini model/prompt/context combinations against the versioned AI regression corpus. Capture latency, cost, schema validity, groundedness, usefulness and evidence quality before promoting a model configuration into production.
similarityKeys: gemini api model router and experiment bench

ideas.title: AI Studio Prompt-to-Tool Prototyping Bridge
ideas.summary: Use Google AI Studio as an experimentation donor for structured-output prompts, multimodal inputs, function/tool calling and model behavior. ViewTube should import proven prompt contracts and tests—not create a permanent second prompt authority.

ideas.title: Gemini Notebook Auto-Learning Library Builder
ideas.summary: Turn completed Projects, postmortems, high-performing videos and verified reference docs into source-grounded creator notebooks. The system could generate a “what we learned” brief, glossary, study guide, infographic or video overview and then publish approved versions into the ViewTube Library page.

ideas.title: Cross-Modal Brand Consistency Engine
ideas.summary: Use Gemini reasoning plus Nano Banana/Veo/Flow references to compare thumbnails, frames, generated video and audio against the creator’s Style Fingerprint. Instead of a single vague style score, show concrete mismatches in palette, typography, subject treatment, pacing, camera language and recurring motifs.

ideas.title: Multimodal Adaptation Factory
ideas.summary: Take one approved long-form ContentBuild and generate a governed adaptation plan for Shorts, teaser clips, thumbnail/key-art variants, localized versions, alternate intros, social cutdowns and music treatments. Each derivative remains linked to the source ContentBuild and records which Google model/tool created it.

ideas.title: How YouTube Recommendations and Discovery Work
ideas.summary: A plain-language but evidence-grounded guide to Home/Browse, Suggested/Related, Search, Shorts Feed, subscriptions, notifications and other discovery surfaces—and what creators can and cannot infer about “the algorithm.”
similarityKeys: how youtube recommendations and discovery work

ideas.title: YouTube Metrics and Dimensions Master Glossary
ideas.summary: Definitions for views, engaged views, watch time, average view duration, average percentage viewed, impressions, CTR, unique viewers, subscribers gained/lost, revenue, RPM/CPM-style measures, traffic dimensions, geography, device, content type and other analytics fields.
similarityKeys: youtube metrics and dimensions master glossary

ideas.title: Shorts vs Long-Form: Different Systems, Different Signals
ideas.summary: Explain format differences in viewer behavior, distribution, retention interpretation, packaging, session behavior, monetization, cadence, creative structure and the danger of comparing unlike metrics directly.
similarityKeys: shorts vs long-form: different systems, different signals

ideas.title: Publishing Best Practices and Preflight Checklist
ideas.summary: A step-by-step reference covering metadata, title, description, tags where useful, thumbnail, captions, audience settings, visibility, schedule, playlists, chapters, end screens/cards where applicable, rights checks, quality control and post-publish verification.
similarityKeys: publishing best practices and preflight checklist

ideas.title: Thumbnail and Title Packaging Handbook
ideas.summary: A practical guide to promise, clarity, curiosity, subject hierarchy, text restraint, contrast, mobile readability, title-thumbnail complementarity, variant testing and diagnosing high-retention/low-CTR versus high-CTR/low-satisfaction patterns.

ideas.title: Audience Retention and Watch Behavior Guide
ideas.summary: Explain retention curves, intros, dips, spikes, average percentage viewed, duration effects, chapter/segment analysis, Shorts looping behavior and how not to overreact to small samples.
similarityKeys: audience retention and watch behavior guide

ideas.title: Traffic Sources and Discovery Pathways
ideas.summary: Explain Browse, Suggested/Related, Search, External, Channel pages, Shorts Feed, playlists, notifications, end screens, hashtags, sound pages, remixes and other traffic sources, including how the same video can behave differently across them.

ideas.title: Audience, Subscribers and Returning Viewers
ideas.summary: Explain subscriber gains/losses, new vs returning viewers, viewer loyalty, audience overlap, cohort thinking, why subscriber count is not the same as active audience, and how to interpret subscriber conversion without chasing vanity metrics.

ideas.title: YouTube Revenue and Monetization Fundamentals
ideas.summary: Explain estimated revenue, ad revenue, Premium revenue, monetized playbacks, CPM/RPM concepts, memberships, fan funding, shopping/commerce considerations and why revenue reports can change after initial estimates.

ideas.title: Live Streaming Operations Handbook
ideas.summary: Cover scheduling, stream setup, encoder/health checks, chat moderation, DVR/latency choices, live analytics, monetization considerations, failure recovery and how to repurpose the archive afterward.

ideas.title: Playlist, Series and Channel Architecture Guide
ideas.summary: Explain playlists as viewer journeys, series structure, channel homepage sections, sequencing, evergreen versus campaign playlists, internal routing and how playlists differ from simple folders.
similarityKeys: playlist, series and channel architecture guide

ideas.title: Comments, Community and Audience Feedback Playbook
ideas.summary: Cover moderation, response prioritization, recurring-question mining, suggested-video replies, handling criticism, identifying content opportunities and separating anecdotal comments from statistically meaningful audience evidence.
similarityKeys: comments, community and audience feedback playbook

ideas.title: Content Planning, Experiments and Learning Loops
ideas.summary: Teach creators how to move from idea → hypothesis → package → publish → measurement → outcome → learning, including test design, avoiding simultaneous uncontrolled changes and recording what actually changed.
similarityKeys: content planning, experiments and learning loops

ideas.title: Copyright, Rights, Reuse and AI-Generated Media Reference
ideas.summary: A creator-oriented reference for music, footage, images, remixes, licensing, claims/strikes, attribution, AI-generated assets, provenance and when to seek official/legal guidance rather than relying on assumptions.
similarityKeys: copyright, rights, reuse and ai-generated media reference

ideas.title: Reading Analytics Correctly: Scope, Windows, Missingness and Statistical Traps
ideas.summary: Explain time-window mismatches, lifecycle windows, percentages versus counts, sparse data, delayed metrics, geography/sample limitations, invalid cross-format comparisons, correlation versus causation and why “up” or “down” does not automatically explain why.
similarityKeys: reading analytics correctly: scope, windows, missingness and statistical traps

ideas.title: Creator Mission Control
ideas.summary: A Studio Hub command surface that shows the active Project, current ContentBuild, blockers, next action, pending approvals, publishing readiness, recent anomalies and the most important evidence-backed recommendation without becoming another Brain.

ideas.title: Research-to-Project Builder
ideas.summary: Turn a research brief, Gemini Notebook, URL set, transcript bundle or Brain conversation into a real Project with goals, evidence, tasks, script outline, asset slots and a ContentBuild identity in one guided flow.

ideas.title: Packaging Laboratory
ideas.summary: A dedicated title-thumbnail-description experimentation workspace with variant sets, evidence, rubric comparison, creator selection, historical performance context and later outcome attribution to the exact package used.

ideas.title: Publish Flight Deck
ideas.summary: A dense but visual final readiness tool showing VIDEO → PACKAGE → RIGHTS → METADATA → AUDIENCE → SCHEDULE → APPROVAL → PUBLISH → VERIFY. It should absorb duplicate preflight/checklist surfaces rather than add another parallel publisher.

ideas.title: Video Lifecycle Timeline
ideas.summary: A single chronological view of idea, research, project creation, script, generated assets, edits, render, package approval, publish, analytics checkpoints, experiments, comments, outcomes and learned corrections for one video.

ideas.title: Project Dependency and Blocker Radar
ideas.summary: Visualize tasks and assets that are actually preventing completion: missing thumbnail choice, unresolved research claim, render failure, auth problem, unapproved package, absent captions or incomplete rights review. Rank blockers by downstream impact.

ideas.title: Content Experiment Manager
ideas.summary: Create experiments around packaging, intro structure, publishing time, format or follow-up strategy; lock the hypothesis and changed variables; then join measured results back to the exact variant and ContentBuild.

ideas.title: Retention Scene and Chapter Diagnostics
ideas.summary: Overlay retention behavior on chapters, transcript sections, edit markers and scene boundaries so creators can see where viewer behavior changes relative to actual content structure rather than only a generic line chart.

ideas.title: Traffic Pathway Explorer
ideas.summary: A flow/network visualization showing how viewers arrive through Search, Browse, Suggested, playlists, external sources, Shorts Feed, channel pages and internal routing, then where they go next when evidence is available.

ideas.title: Audience Cohort Workbench
ideas.summary: Compare new viewers, returning viewers, subscriber conversion, geography, device, format, traffic-source and lifecycle cohorts with strict metric-compatibility rules. Save useful cohorts as reusable analytics lenses rather than permanent duplicate datasets.

ideas.title: Revenue Opportunity Analyzer
ideas.summary: Join content type, traffic, geography, watch behavior, ad/Premium revenue, memberships and publishing cadence to identify where revenue changes came from—while separating observed data from inferred opportunity.

ideas.title: Series and Playlist Architect
ideas.summary: Plan a multi-video series visually, assign Projects/ContentBuilds to episodes, define playlist order, internal routing, follow-up candidates, recurring assets and publication cadence, then sync the supported playlist structure to YouTube.

ideas.title: Comment-to-Content Opportunity Miner
ideas.summary: Cluster repeated viewer questions, requests and pain points across comments; connect clusters to existing videos/projects; estimate evidence strength; and create a Project or follow-up idea only after creator approval.

ideas.title: Channel Change Journal and Outcome Map
ideas.summary: Automatically log significant creator actions—new thumbnail, title change, publish, playlist move, live event, experiment, major editor revision—and overlay later analytics so creators can inspect correlations without pretending they prove causation.
similarityKeys: channel change journal and outcome map

ideas.title: Scenario Planner
ideas.summary: Let creators model “what if” plans such as more Shorts, fewer but larger long-form uploads, a weekly live stream, a sequel series or different publishing cadence. Use historical channel evidence to show assumptions and ranges, not fake forecasts or guaranteed outcomes.
